question: Where should these ritual elements be placed during the installation procedure?
premises: etāny refers to elements to be placed
aṃguṣṭhādiṣu specifies thumb and related locations
hṛdayādiṣu vinyaset prescribes placement on heart and related locations
inference: These should be placed on the thumbs and so forth and on the heart and so forth.
uncertainties: The specific elements referred to by etāny are not named in this verse.
plain_english: One should place these on the thumbs and so forth and on the heart and so forth.
